_status: DRAFT v3 (owner-approved Option C from docs/M1_BALANCE_REVIEW.md, 2026-10-18) - trial values, NOT locked; per-turn timing must be measured after M2. All money is integer RC.

max_rounds_by_players._rule: Round cap by number of seated players at match start (bankruptcies do not change it). max_rounds is the fallback for any player count not listed.

wealth_tax._formula: tax = min(cap, floor(taxable_wealth * pct / 100)); taxable_wealth = cash + sum(liquidation value of owned properties incl. buildings) = MVP net worth

rent_multiplier_pct._rule: rent = base_rent * pct / 100. Exactly ONE row applies (no stacking): level 0 uses 'level0_incomplete' or 'level0_district_complete'; levels 1-3 already include the district-completion value and never get the 2x on top.
